description: This file defines an interface for a platform service related to repayments with post-dated checks, including methods for deleting, updating, and bouncing checks.

classes.name: RepaymentWithPostDatedChecksWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface specifying methods for managing post-dated checks within the repayment process.

methods.name: deletePostDatedChecks
methods.description: Deletes a post-dated check based on the provided command.

methods.name: updatePostDatedChecks
methods.description: Updates details of a post-dated check based on the provided command.

methods.name: bouncePostDatedChecks
methods.description: Marks a post-dated check as bounced based on the provided command.
